text:
rachel: OK folks — Q3 roadmap sync: we need to lock the Private deployment launch checklist. Main open items: offline/airgap packaging approach, VPC control plane minimal features, SLA wording for Dedicated vs Private, and stability gating. Customers are pushing for an HSM/KMS story. Thoughts on phasing?
ben: +1 on phasing. proposal: Phase 1 = VPC control plane (managed networking + k8s operator + basic RBAC), Phase 2 = full on-prem packaging (deb/rpm, helm, operator images), Phase 3 = airgap/offline installer + HSM integrations.
rachel: That aligns with what I sketched. Key question: do we require HSM in Phase 1 for some enterprise pilot customers?
kiran: For regulated customers, HSM is a must. But HSM integration adds sig and packaging complexity (HSM libs, PKCS#11). Recommend keep HSM as Phase 2 (pilot) unless contractually required. We can offer KMS proxy in Phase 1.
jessica: From support side — Phase 1 must include clear diagnostics and rollback docs. Airgapped installs without proper telemetry are going to blow up. We need an offline support bundle and a documented debug flow.
sam: Can we document a minimal acceptance criteria for Phase 1? e.g., "deploy in 2 AZs, KV store encrypted, control-plane HA, 99.9% uptime in CI, smoke test pass" — short list so sales can sign pilots.
rachel: Yes. Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Control plane HA across AZs; 2) API surface parity with hosted for authentication/rollouts; 3) Operator-managed upgrades with canary; 4) Offline install sanity checks. Open to edits.
ben: Also need to specify resource/scale targets: N=10 customers at 2k rps aggregate for Phase 1, and verification tests for cold start latency.
oliver: Legal flagged license activation for offline installs — we need an offline activation flow (license file + org token) and clear expiry/renewal process. Also audit trail requirement from gov customers.
rachel: Good call. @oliver please coordinate with legal to draft wording for SLA/activation.
deploy-bot: deploy report: staging-controlplane v1.5.2 promoted to canary cluster — smoke tests: 12/12 passed.
jessica: Nice. But note: some tests don't exercise PKCS11 path. We should add a nightly test job that runs HSM mock if possible.
kiran: We can add a software HSM mock for CI to validate integration, yes. For airgap we also need to ship verified checksums and optional Sigstore attestations.
sam: On timelines — Product wants Phase 1 GA in 8 weeks, Phase 2 in 16. Is that realistic?
ben: 8 weeks for control plane GA is tight but doable if we freeze scope. No full HSM, no advanced telemetry in Phase 1. Need two engineer sprints focused on operator stability, one on packaging automation.
rachel: Freeze scope then: Phase 1 excludes HSM, excludes offline license activation (we'll provide manual process), includes KMS proxy, HA control plane, operator upgrades, basic docs, and pilot SLAs. Phase 2 will add HSM integration, automated offline installer, and signed images.
jessica: Support caveat — manual license activation for pilots will increase onboarding time by ~1-2 days. Document this as part of pilot expectations.
oliver: Legal will accept manual activation for pilots if we add checklist and retention policy.
kiran: Security caveat: airgap images must be reproducible and include SBOMs. Also plan for key rotation procedure.
rachel: OK. Action items: 1) ben — produce minimal Phase 1 tech spec + resource estimate by EOD Friday; 2) kiran — HSM integration plan draft for Phase 2 by next Wed; 3) oliver — license + SLA wording draft by next Tue; 4) jessica — support runbook skeleton by EOD Monday.
ben: will do. I’ll include a small bake test matrix and rollback plan.
kiran: I’ll include PKCS11 options (SoftHSM, cloud HSM adapters) and a CI mock.
jessica: I’ll draft the runbook and offline support checklist.
sam: I'll prep a short note for sales with pilot caveats and estimated onboarding time.
rachel: Thanks team. If no major objections I’ll move this plan into the quarterly roadmap doc and set OKR placeholders: PrivateDeploy.GA = Phase1 GA, PrivateDeploy.HSM = Phase2.
ben: :thumbsup:
jessica: :+1:
deploy-bot: reminder: weekly roadmap sync in 3 days at 10:00am.
